    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "A single line edit in CMakeLists.txt supporting platform socket headers merely follows from the socket functionality required by P2P.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not belong to Build and CI as the single-line CMake change is incidental to the P2P networking feature."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the P2P label and directly modifies compact block relay logic in src/net_processing.cpp and src/net.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Predictive prefilling limited by TCP congestion window substantially reduces block propagation latency across the network. Measurements show reconstruction without an extra round-trip rises from 56.9% to 89.7% with minimal bandwidth overhead (~1.39 MiB/day)."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Fuzz and unit test adjustments in src/test/fuzz/ and src/bench/ test the compact block and socket changes rather than test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Does not belong to Test infrastructure because the test updates specifically pin compact block relay and socket behaviors rather than test harness machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds +130 lines to src/util/sock.h and +46 lines to src/util/sock.cpp implementing cross-platform TCP window and queue querying APIs.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Expands the shared Sock abstraction with cross-platform OS socket inspection (ioctl and getsockopt for Linux, macOS, BSD, and Windows). While motivated by P2P, reviewers of the utility layer must assess the portability and correctness of these socket primitives."
    }
  ],
